misconceptions.title: Forgetting 1 kN·m = 10⁶ N·mm in Bending Stress
misconceptions.description: Dividing bending moment in kN·m by section modulus in mm³ without multiplying by 10⁶ (or only multiplying by 10³).
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Write units explicitly at every step: 1 kN = 10³ N and 1 m = 10³ mm, so 1 kN·m = 10⁶ N·mm. Verify that N·mm / mm³ = N/mm² = MPa.

misconceptions.title: Confusing First Moment of Area (Q) with Elastic Section Modulus (W_el)
misconceptions.description: Treating First Moment of Area Q and Elastic Section Modulus W_el as interchangeable because both have units of mm³ (L³).
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Contrast their physical definitions: Q = ∫y dA measures area moment of a slice for shear flow (τ = VQ/Ib), whereas W_el = I / y_max relates total bending moment to extreme-fibre normal stress (σ = M / W_el).

misconceptions.title: Treating Second Moment of Area (I) as Material Strength or Resistance Alone
misconceptions.description: Assuming I (mm⁴) directly gives bending strength without considering extreme fibre distance y_max, material yield strength f_y, or elastic modulus E.
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Distinguish geometry (I in mm⁴), flexural stiffness (EI in N·mm²), elastic stress governor (W_el = I/y_max in mm³), and material resistance.

misconceptions.title: Incomplete Free-Body Diagram or Incorrect Support Restraint
misconceptions.description: Omitting a moment restraint at a fixed support, or adding a horizontal reaction where a roller permits free translation.
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Ask: 'Which translations and rotations does this support physically prevent?' Each prevented degree of freedom corresponds to exactly one reaction component.

misconceptions.title: Using Inclined Member Length Instead of Perpendicular Lever Arm
misconceptions.description: Multiplying a force by the total distance to the pivot rather than the perpendicular distance (or failing to resolve the force into orthogonal components first).
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Use Varignon's principle: resolve the inclined force into horizontal and vertical components at a known point, then multiply each by its clear orthogonal coordinate distance.

misconceptions.title: Reversing Shear Jump Direction or Sign Convention at Point Loads
misconceptions.description: Losing track of whether a downward point load causes a downward step in the SFD under the UK left-up/right-down positive shear convention.
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Draw a tiny differential beam slice Δx straddling the point load and enforce vertical equilibrium ΣF_y = 0.

misconceptions.title: Expecting a Concentrated Couple to Jump the Shear Diagram Instead of the BMD
misconceptions.description: Applying a point moment (couple) as a jump on the SFD rather than a sudden vertical discontinuity on the BMD.
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Show from ΣF_y = 0 that a pure couple adds zero net vertical force (no jump in V), while ΣM = 0 across an infinitesimal slice produces an immediate step ΔM in the BMD.

misconceptions.title: Applying M = PL/4 or wL²/8 Outside Simply Supported Symmetric Conditions
misconceptions.description: Using standard textbook formulas when the beam has an overhang, off-centre load, cantilever support, or end couple.
misconceptions.remediation_strategy: Always verify boundary conditions first; determine reactions from global equilibrium and make an explicit section cut.

objectives.title: Structural Units, Dimensional Homogeneity & Power Scaling
objectives.observable_competency: Convert fluently between N/kN/MN, mm/cm/m, mm²/mm³/mm⁴, kN·m/N·mm, and MPa/N/mm², and verify dimensional consistency of structural equations before substituting numbers.
objectives.why_it_matters: Factor-of-1,000 errors in kN·m to N·mm or m⁴ to mm⁴ invalidate otherwise sound engineering analysis.

objectives.title: Rapid Trigonometry, Force Resolution & Slope Ratios
objectives.observable_competency: Decompose inclined forces and member geometries into orthogonal components using both angles (sin/cos) and 3-4-5 / rise-run slope ratios without sign confusion.
objectives.why_it_matters: Fast, reliable component resolution is essential for trusses, raking props, and triangulated brackets.

objectives.title: Visual Calculus for Engineers: Slopes (d/dx) and Accumulated Areas (∫ dx)
objectives.observable_competency: Interpret derivatives as local diagram gradients and integrals as accumulated areas under curves to link load intensity w(x), shear V(x), moment M(x), slope θ(x), and deflection δ(x).
objectives.why_it_matters: Eliminates memorisation of SFD/BMD curve shapes by revealing why constant load gives linear shear and parabolic moment.

objectives.title: Support Idealisations, Restraints & Free-Body Diagrams (FBDs)
objectives.observable_competency: Translate real structural connections into idealised pin, roller, fixed, or hanger supports, isolate a valid FBD, and justify every reaction component.
objectives.why_it_matters: Every hand calculation and finite-element model stands or falls on whether the boundary conditions match physical reality.

objectives.title: Translational & Rotational Equilibrium (ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0, ΣM = 0)
objectives.observable_competency: Calculate global support reactions for asymmetric beams, cantilevers, and frames with eccentric loads and applied couples, and verify using an independent moment point.
objectives.why_it_matters: If support reactions are wrong, every downstream internal force, SFD, and BMD is guaranteed to be wrong.

objectives.title: Static Determinacy, Stability, Mechanisms & Load Paths
objectives.observable_competency: Trace how gravity and lateral loads travel from application point to foundation, and distinguish stable determinate structures from unstable mechanisms or indeterminate systems.
objectives.why_it_matters: Recognising an unstable arrangement or missing bracing path prevents catastrophic collapses and software modelling blunders.

objectives.title: Method of Sections & Internal Resultants (N, V, M)
objectives.observable_competency: Cut an arbitrary structural member, expose internal axial force N, shear force V, and bending moment M using the UK sign convention, and solve for them via equilibrium of the isolated sub-body.
objectives.why_it_matters: Connects external loads to the internal actions that material cross-sections must actually resist.

objectives.title: Simply Supported & Cantilever Beams under Point Loads and UDLs
objectives.observable_competency: Construct accurate SFDs and BMDs (plotted on the tension face) for simply supported and cantilever beams, explaining shear jumps and moment peaks from equilibrium.
objectives.why_it_matters: Forms the everyday baseline of member sizing and quick sense-checking of structural software.

objectives.title: Differential Load–Shear–Moment Relationships & Extrema
objectives.observable_competency: Use dV/dx = -w(x) and dM/dx = V(x) to locate zero-shear points, calculate exact maximum sagging/hogging moments, and handle Concentrated Point Couples.
objectives.why_it_matters: Allows rapid analysis of partial UDLs and asymmetric loads where maximum moment does not occur at midspan.

objectives.title: Complex Beams: Overhangs, Piecewise Regions & Triangular Loads
objectives.observable_competency: Segment multi-region beams with overhangs, combined point/partial-UDL/triangular loads, identify sagging-to-hogging contraflexure points, and perform independent boundary checks.
objectives.why_it_matters: Real-world beams frequently cantilever past supports or carry hydrostatic/earth triangular pressures.

objectives.title: Pin-Jointed Trusses, Zero-Force Members & Method of Joints/Sections
objectives.observable_competency: Determine tension/compression in truss members, identify zero-force members by inspection, and explain the assumptions behind pin-jointed truss idealisations.
objectives.why_it_matters: Enables quick manual verification of roof trusses, lattice girders, and bracing frames.

objectives.title: Triangulated Wall Brackets, Eccentric Connections & Portal/Braced Frames
objectives.observable_competency: Analyse force flow through wall-mounted triangular brackets and simple frames, distinguishing global wall anchor reactions from local member axial/shear/bending actions.
objectives.why_it_matters: Directly bridges theoretical statics with practical steelwork brackets, platforms, and frame stability.

objectives.title: Area (A), Centroids & First Moment of Area (Q)
objectives.observable_competency: Compute cross-sectional area, locate the centroid of asymmetric shapes (T-sections, channels, angles), and calculate First Moment of Area Q (mm³) while distinguishing it from Section Modulus.
objectives.why_it_matters: Finding the neutral axis and understanding Q (L³) is prerequisite to bending and shear stress analysis.

objectives.title: Second Moment of Area (I), Parallel Axis Theorem & Section Moduli (W_el vs W_pl)
objectives.observable_competency: Calculate planar I = bd³/12 and composite I via the Parallel Axis Theorem (I_total = Σ(I_c + A·d²)), compute W_el and W_pl, and explain why depth cubed dominates flexural stiffness.
objectives.why_it_matters: Explains why I-beams, channels, and deep timber joists work efficiently and how to read steel/timber section tables accurately.

objectives.title: Axial, Bending (σ = My/I = M/W_el) & Shear Stress Distributions
objectives.observable_competency: Calculate combined axial and bending stresses with strict unit consistency, sketch stress blocks across elastic and plastic sections, and distinguish stiffness (E, EI) from strength (f_y).
objectives.why_it_matters: Links internal actions (N, V, M) and section geometry (A, W_el, I) to material stress limits.

objectives.title: Flexural Stiffness (EI), Beam Deflection, Slenderness & Buckling Stability
objectives.observable_competency: Evaluate how span, boundary conditions, E, and I govern beam deflection and Euler/member buckling (effective length L_cr, radius of gyration i, slenderness λ).
objectives.why_it_matters: Slender compression struts and unbraced beams frequently fail by buckling or serviceability deflection long before material yield.

objectives.title: Eurocode Basis of Design (EN 1990/1991), Limit States & Software Output Interrogation
objectives.observable_competency: Formulate ULS and SLS load combinations, trace partial factors, and independently interrogate structural analysis software reactions, deformed shapes, and equilibrium checks.
objectives.why_it_matters: Ensures code compliance and guards against 'garbage-in, garbage-out' reliance on analysis software.

objectives.title: Steel (EN 1993) & Timber (EN 1995 / Eurocode 5) Member Design Workflows
objectives.observable_competency: Execute source-grounded member checks for steel (cross-section classification, shear, bending, LTB, compression buckling) and timber (grain directionality, k_mod, k_def, combined stresses) using supplied code editions.
objectives.why_it_matters: Translates mechanics fundamentals into verifiable UK Eurocode design calculations.

objectives.title: Propping, Needling, Falsework Load Paths & BS 5975 Context
objectives.observable_competency: Apply statics, load paths, eccentricity, stability bracing, and bearing checks to temporary propping and needling schemes while distinguishing BS 5975 procedural guidance from Eurocode member checks.
objectives.why_it_matters: Connects your practical temporary-works design experience directly to rigorous first-principles mechanics.
